integrity: Complete reproducible finite enumeration and independently implemented Euler-tour cross-check; no probabilistic sampling. Embedded standalone code checks all 65536 BWT block orientations and all 2048 necklaces.
scientific_limitations: Only order-five binary de Bruijn necklaces, sentinel-free cyclic-rotation BWT, and ordinary linear runs. Finite exhaustive enumeration; no all-order statement. The literature search is not an exhaustive historical-priority proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Complete BWT-run spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
